variants.title: Bruised twilight

variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: LCL darker-watercolour exploration round02, image r02-04-bruised.
Input images: IMAGE1 original rail station is exact composition reference; IMAGE2 previous watercolor station is medium lineage only, its brightness is not desired. Repaint image1's exact scene in visibly hand-painted watercolor, substantially moodier than image2. An aubergine, dusty mauve, slate and muted coral twilight, like bruised dusk. Translucent violet pigment pooling, broad uneven wet-in-wet washes, paper tooth, granulation, blooms and broken drybrush. Selective thin ink helps three small human silhouettes and station interaction objects; simplify repetitive industrial microdetail. A tiny warm workbench lamp sustains melancholy human warmth; dim existing wall lights and dispenser preserve legible wayfinding. Dark mood through expressive pigments and contrast, not simply black exposure. Keep pale dusty-rose light softly separating floors from machinery. Actual watercolor illustration, not 3D model with noise overlay.
INVARIANTS: fixed elevated OVERHEAD three-quarter oblique/trimetric near-parallel projection, identical original wide framing and continuous station floor fills entire image. Gallery and stairs left; upperleft workbench with ONE repairer; lowerleft bench with ONE seated person, cushion, existing plant and tea table; central pier with relay and dispenser; ONE waiting protagonist at CLOSED transparent gate midright; freight rails, crane and containers right. Exactly three people in original positions. Same object locations, paths, gate closure, topology, camera and scale. Existing signs may be simplified to pictograms. No new objects.
Avoid: cinematic lens, horizon, perspective recession, floating diorama, borders, UI, readable writing, watermark, new plants/people, photorealism, smooth CGI, purely black darkening. Landscape16:9.

Broad dark-sage, viridian, petrol-green and dirty-bone washes; visibly uneven wet-in-wet green pigment blooms, tide marks and coarse paper granulation. Use flat translucent wash masses instead of modeled shiny 3D surfaces. Deliberately discard microdetail (individual floor tiles, fasteners, rails teeth, crane rivets) while retaining all gameplay object silhouettes. Broken drybrush and sparse dark ink contours on key edges. No polished CGI or embossed brush texture. Eerie green-gray diffuse mist makes maintained civic machines feel haunted; dim existing amber lamps are small human anchors. Subtle botanical etched curves on existing fixtures only, as if historical civic ornament shines through green oxidation, NOT actual plants growing. Not a forest, not horror monsters. Soft parchment floor highlights keep walkable spaces and people legible amid dark green machinery. Painterly melancholy through pigment and atmosphere, not black exposure.
INVARIANTS: exact original fixed elevated OVERHEAD three-quarter oblique/trimetric near-parallel camera and wide framing; continuous station playfield fills image. Gallery/stairs left. ONE repairer at workbench upperleft. ONE seated person on bench, cushion, existing plant and tea table lowerleft. Central pier has relay and dispenser. ONE waiting protagonist beside CLOSED glass gate midright. Right side freight rails, overhead crane, containers. Exactly three people, all original positions. Preserve layout, path topology, mainobject proportions and station continuity. Rails remain straight, machinery maintained. No new objects/plants/people.
Avoid: perspective cinematic lens/horizon, floating diorama, borders/UI/text/watermark, smooth modeled 3D, sharp microdetail everywhere, new vegetation, creatures, gratuitous rust. Landscape16:9.
